verses.1: May they be destroyed by those who are wise and skilled in poetry.
verses.2: I have a good thought in my heart. I will speak to the king and ask for a new scribe who can write quickly.
verses.3: May God bless you forever, for you have been created in His image. May He honor you with His blessings.
verses.4: May your days be filled with joy and happiness, as you walk along the path of your Lord.
verses.5: And may your path be one of truth and righteousness. May your ways be bright and shining, in your right hand.
verses.6: Your two nations will fall under your control; their hearts will be filled with hatred towards the king.
verses.7: Your throne shall be a place where God reigns forever and ever. It will be the source of your kingdom.
verses.8: You loved righteousness, but you hated the wicked. Therefore, your God, your Lord, has punished you for your actions.
verses.9: May your curtains be made of fine materials, from the finest fabrics. From the chambers of Shelan, they shall bring you joy.
verses.10: In your days, daughters of kings stand before you; they are placed in your hands as offerings.
verses.11: Listen to their words and their actions. Then, turn away from your people and your father’s house.
verses.12: And the king will be pleased, for he is the Lord. And worship him!
verses.13: And in the land of Zor, with their faces turned away, the rich men began to act recklessly.
verses.14: All the splendor of the Queen’s robes was made of gold.
verses.15: To the idols, Tobal will go to the king. His enemies will come to him in his own form.
verses.16: We will be happy and full of joy, and we will enter the palace of the king.
verses.17: Under your fathers, your sons will be established, and they will rule over all the earth.
verses.18: Let your name be remembered in every place, and thus the nations will forever honor you.
